name: Sumeragi Haneru
source:
"Yes! "Kemonomichi☆Girlish Square" Let's go!"

She is the leader of the underground idol group "Kemonomichi☆Girlish Square" based in Akiba, Japan.

She is a former top idol who used to be a member of a national idol group.

She left the group for some reason, but is now working hard with her new friends to make a comeback.

She has a strong sense that her experience should make her stronger, and she encourages others to do the same, but she is often spinning out of control.

Because she devotes herself to her idol activities, she lives in a shabby apartment and has a hard time making a living.

Accompanying magical creature: Pen (Penguin)

[Based on the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/kemonomichi-gs/character/]official website[/url]]
